verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm with an IP practice, so trade-secret work is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions trade secrets, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. The closest items are a generic accolade that its team 'can handle all types of IP litigation' and separate patent and trade-mark pages, which are adjacent and do not document this specific capability.
